title: [Runner] Fix false-positive Win+Shift+C shortcut conflict on Windows 11

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The literal suggestion candidate previously passed focused validation, but pristine upstream remains unvalidated. The latest explicit-project restore spawned MSBuild before the private wrapper failed while assigning a reserved PowerShell variable. The process identifier and exit result were not retained, so that attempt has an unknown result. A subsequent read-only reconciliation found no running MSBuild process or process targeting that project; the expected native imports remain absent. The wrapper now waits for process completion and drains output before logging, but the correction has only been statically checked, not rerun. Runner and unit-test builds, test discovery, and the original focused upstream test remain unrun. Round 3 was Lite, not full agentic review; five comments were resolved, while the remaining thread concerns a test seam introduced by the review candidate rather than an upstream defect. No convergence or author-facing action is claimed.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
